signs: per-feature sign from the 150 IndEgo gold windows ONLY: +1 if IndEgo AUROC >= 0.5 else -1
zscore: per-domain: subtract the target domain's own feature mean and divide by its own std; computed ONCE on the pooled 160 and sliced by batch (q1/q2 are slices, not per-batch z-scores); unsupervised (no labels); transductive
threshold: 0 for the z-score combos (the pooled signed-mean centre), 0.5 for probability scorers; no OOD threshold tuning
score: equal-weight mean of (z-scored feature * IndEgo sign)
evaluation: AUROC + balanced accuracy; factory-grouped bootstrap CI (honest, n_boot=2000, seed=0); window bootstrap optimistic
confirmatory_plan: freeze this recipe BEFORE labelling the new 400-window set (queue 3, labels3.json); score it once, unchanged; that single number replaces the pooled-160 claim
